name: schema
sql: CREATE TABLE t(id BIGINT PRIMARY KEY,s VARCHAR(24000),v VECTOR(3))

name: wide-external-sort
sql: SELECT id FROM t ORDER BY s ASC

name: wide-topk
sql: SELECT id FROM t ORDER BY L2_DISTANCE(v,[0,0,0]) ASC LIMIT 10

name: wide-external-sort
sql: SELECT id FROM t ORDER BY s DESC

name: wide-topk
sql: SELECT id FROM t ORDER BY L2_DISTANCE(v,[0,0,0]) DESC LIMIT 10

name: response-spill
sql: SELECT id,s FROM t ORDER BY id LIMIT 32

name: wide-index
sql: CREATE VECTOR INDEX ix ON t(v)

name: wide-index-filter
sql: SELECT id FROM t WHERE id>=700 ORDER BY L2_DISTANCE(v,[0,0,0]) LIMIT 10
